176-4875-6495.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat.
176-4875-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat

539-3821-4679-5686-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-5686-6023.description:

Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-7175-8190.description:

Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1339-3188-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3188-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

240-728-5295-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3365-5742-5743-7824.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Aeromoeba ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2086-5256-6996.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

206-1170-1329-1492.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
206-1170-1329-1492.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1127-3152-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Mona Lisa.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-4373-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1086-2034-2919-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-2034-2919-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1482-6968.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4907-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

1251-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1251-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

1978-5527-5793.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-5527-5793.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat

56-443-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

856-5670-6748.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
856-5670-6748.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Treasure, which is a Food due to Ragost, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2438-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

108-4499-6753.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
When Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

997-2281-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

997-1329-2178-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
997-1329-2178-3652.description:

Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1434-3774-6220.description:
Activate Chandra's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate the token's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating a token copy of the Chandra with Luxior attached.
Repeat step 2.

2034-2232-4681-4766.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a creature you control.
2034-2232-4681-4766.notablePrerequisites: If the creature with Deathrender attached is an artifact creature, you have a nonartifact creature card in your graveyard.
2034-2232-4681-4766.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Deathrender triggers, putting Karmic Guide from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any nonartifact creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Karmic Guide from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Deathrender's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.

116-2569-4089.notablePrerequisites:
Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-4089.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore.
Activate Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore by tapping it.
When Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

509-1267-5517-5547.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Medomai the Ageless has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
509-1267-5517-5547.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

933-1558-2499-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

579-2540-4824.notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Soliton has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
579-2540-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

465-1430-4089.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic to the battlefield as a copy of Mirror Image, thus making it a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

You have a way to draw a card.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
"Insect" chosen with Engineered Plague.
90-1339-3394.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4499-4685.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prosperous Pirates.
Prosperous Pirates enters the battlefield, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1110-2906-2931-5256.description:

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Faceless One.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
